text:
Alyssa: taking EU handoff now. Sam is primary, Devon is secondary. Noticed rising tails on /v1/generate in eu-west-1 — customers reporting p95 ~700ms. Starting triage. :eyes:
SRE-Bot: New incident INC-2026-0429 created. Trigger: 5m rolling p95 latency >600ms on eu-west-1 for route /v1/generate. Paging oncall-sre. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0429
Sam: ack — on it. First steps: check QPS, GPU util, autoscaler, and kvcache hit rate. If cache is cold, consider prefix prewarm.
Devon: briefing noted. If Sam needs to hand off, I’m ready. Autoscaler dashboard shows two dedicated-eu nodes at ~94% GPU util.
Maria: FYI escalation policy: if p95 >600ms for >5m OR error rate >3% for >10m, page eng-platform. If it hits p95 >1s or error rate >5% page all-hands.
Sam: quick checks: GPU util 91% on two hosts, kvcache hit rate 18% (cold), error rate 0.4%. Looks like cache-cold plus short QPS spike. Plan: enable prefix cache for that route and shift 12% of traffic to redwood-small-q4 fallback to relieve tail while cache warms.
Alyssa: can you paste the runbook link and exact commands you’ll run so I can copy to incident timeline? I’ll draft a customer-safe status update.
Sam: runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/eu-servicing-latency. Commands I’ll run now:
```
# enable prefix cache for route in region
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/api/cache/toggle -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","route":"/v1/generate","state":"enable"}'

# adjust routing to send 12% to fallback model
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/api/routing -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","policy":{"type":"weighted","variants":[{"model":"redwood-small-q4","weight":12},{"model":"redwood-1","weight":88}]}}'
```
Devon: watching logs for backpressure/retries. Also monitoring proxy grpc retry counts.
SRE-Bot: Pager: paging oncall-eng-platform (Tony) due to sustained p95 >600ms for 7m. :rotating_light:
Tony: Eng-Platform oncall. If escalated include sampling of request_ids + trace/span ids so I can look for kernel or perf regressions quickly. I can also queue +2 nodes in the dedicated pool if needed — provisioning ~180-240s.
Alyssa: escalation order reminder: oncall-sre -> oncall-eng-platform -> eng-leads. DM customer-success with initial impact note now.
Sam: applied cache toggle and routing change. Immediate effect: p50 dropped from ~320ms to ~190ms, p95 down to ~560ms and trending. Continuing to monitor.
Devon: observed transient grpc retries from proxy to model earlier. After routing change p95 sits around 540-580ms. If p95 >550ms after 5m we should accept scale from Tony.
Maria: posting escalation thresholds in thread for the next shift: immediate page to oncall-sre for any P1 or p95 >1s; page eng-platform for p95 >600ms >5m or errors >3% >10m; eng-leads if unresolved >20m or SLA breach.
Sam: decision tree for now: 1) prefix cache on, 2) 12% traffic to fallback, 3) wait 5m. If p95 >550ms after wait -> scale dedicated-eu +2 nodes.
Alyssa: customer message I’m sending: \"We’re seeing elevated latency for a subset of EU traffic to /v1/generate. Engineers are mitigating (cache warm + fallback routing). No data loss. Next update in 10m.\" Any CS additions?
Devon: adding timeline notes to incident: applied cache and routing at T+2m. Proxy retries reduced, p50 stable, p95 improving slowly.
Tony: ready to scale when you confirm. Sam or Devon, ping me with a thumbs-up in this thread to proceed.
Sam: thumbs-up. Devon please coordinate the pool add if p95 >550ms after the 5m check.
SRE-Bot: INC-2026-0429 status updated: Mitigating. Tags: eu-west-1, latency, kvcache, routing-fallback.
Maria: handoff notes for next oncall: primary Sam (led mitigation), secondary Devon (monitor autoscaler and proxy retries), escalate to Tony if thresholds hit. Include runbook link and commands.
Sam: I’ll keep thread open and do the warm handoff to Devon at 1754320620 UTC unless cleared sooner. If resolved before then I’ll post closure criteria.
Alyssa: great work. I’ll add a short postmortem stub to the incidents channel once we mark resolved. :thumbsup:
Devon: copying actions into timeline and tagging follow-up: prewarm kvcache during low-traffic windows and improve autoscaler SLOs.
SRE-Bot: INC-2026-0429 mitigation applied: cache enabled, routing fallback active. Next review at 1754320620.
Sam: closure criteria: if p95 <400ms and error rate <1% sustained for 10m -> resolve and file a follow-up to tune autoscaler/kvcache prewarm. Otherwise continue escalation per policy.
Alyssa: handoff scheduled Sam -> Devon at 1754320620. Leaving thread open for monitoring.
